lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters forming approximately 5-6 distinct vertical columns between the posterior edge of the pectoral fin and the leading edge of the first dorsal fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity crossing horizontal axes of spots, creating visible grid-like anchor points across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear features on the upper third of the flank characterized by a sharp transition from high-intensity pixels on the dorsal side to low-intensity shadow pixels on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of approximately 6-8 discrete, high-luminance blobs bounded within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple low-contrast, fusiform pixel clusters situated in close proximity to the dorsal fin and ventral abdomen, consistent with associated ichthyological organisms.
